IS: 9548 -1980 




Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



SPECIFICATION FOR 
SNAP HOOK ( STATIC LINE ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for snap hook (static line) used for parachute 
paratroop type PTR-T 730 m. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 to 5. 
2.1 Deviations shall be given in individual figures. 

3. Materials 

3.1 Cover — Cold rolled steel sheet conforming to IS : 4030-1973 'Specification for cold rolled 
carbon steel strip for general engineering purposes ( first revision ) '. 

3.2 Press Button — - Steel conforming to IS : 226-1975 ' Specification for structural standard quality 
( fifth revision ) \ 

3.3 Spring — Spring steel wire conforming to IS : 4454 ( Part I )-1975 ' Specification for patented 
and cold drawn steel wires-unalloyed ( first revision ) '. 

3.4 Safety-Pin — Spring steel conforming to IS : 4454 ( Part I )-1975. 

3.5 Rivet — Shall be aluminium of suitable quality.

(S : 9548 - 1980 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 All sharp edges shall be removed and rounded off. 

4.2 The spring shall be cadmium plated conforming to classification No. Cd12 of IS: 1572-1968 
' Specification for electroplated coatings of cadmium on iron and steel ( first revision ) '. 

4.3 All surfaces shall be free from scales, burrs, pits, tool-marks, etc. 

4.4 The snap hook shall be coated nickel over chromium conforming to Grade 4 of 15:1068-1968 
' Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel ( first revision) '. 

5. Tests 

5.1 The spring shall recoil to its original length after it has been maintained fully compressed for 
48 hours. 

5.2 Test for Snap — The snap shall be suitably spring loaded to ensure that in the normal position 
the snap firmly closes the hook and it shall not be possible to open the hook without a pressure 
between 2 and 4 kg being applied to the snap. After being applied fully and then released repeatedly, 
ten times, the snap shall regain its original position ( closing position ) without permanent set. 

6. Marking — Snap hook shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initial or recognized trade- 
mark. 

6.1 ISf Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7 S Packing — Each snap hook shall be wrapped in tissue paper and then packed in cartons. Each 
carton shall then be marked with manufacturer's name, initials, etc. The snap hook may also be 
packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
